description: Made in the USA! Hosley Set of 2, 230 ml Cinnamon Swirl Scent Reed Diffuser Refill Oil. For use with reed sticks. Create a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere in your home with this diffuser oil. As the fragrance is dispersed throughout your home it will freshen the air and help assist in removing lingering odors, without the use of an open flame. Hosley diffuser oil will fill your space with a pleasant aroma and a sense of tranquility as well as being excellent partners in sleeping, and yoga. Hosley diffuser oils are a perfect source for everyday use. Wrap them up as a gift or use them as a stocking stuffer. Spread these fragrances around and share with your family and friends. Just simply pour the fragrance into a bottle and place your reeds into the diffuser oil. Flip reeds sticks over regularly (recommend 1x per week) to keep the fragrance strong. (Reed Sticks & Bottles Not Included). Instructions: Pour diffuser oil into diffuser bottle. Insert 6 to 10 diffuser reeds. Caution: Skin and eye irritant. Do not ingest. Keep out of reach of children and pets. May damage finished surfaces if spill occurs. Keep away from open flames (do not heat). Contains fragrance oils. Color of oil may vary.
